source_evidence: Player exact 'Allow it. Say: If this is what they are doing to their own people... imagine what is happening in the disputed fronts and borders. I want to find out... I want to take it down. Even if we have to do ourselves.' V authorizes copies, makes exact stated intent to Crown officials; no unchosen additional V testimony, pledge, military action or evidence surrender. Secretary begins copying under supervision; completed certified copies and authentication not yet established. Councillor takes concern seriously without equating Kestrel with all border incidents. Activate existing eligible rumor 2 in prep/dm-only/veyr-western-program-field-operations-dm-only.md, which permits a proper military/border source warning from Orseld post of raiders in rival colors on different nights with mismatched/similar tactics. Fix actual source chronology before disclosure: warning originates from an Orseld-area frontier post D306, ordinary indirect border liaison courier forwarding reaches Caereth D313, security councillor has legitimate access to that report; no exact route mileage or future attack clock invented. He conveys only preliminary report, not proof of false flag or any sponsor; offers access to actual report and written liaison introduction if V wants. No activation of the separate Hollow Pennant threat timetable, no force deployment or specific attack invented, no current location, no disclosure of DM-only Program identities. Crown cannot promise war or sovereign foreign enforcement, offers confidential investigation/appropriate liaison. Companions Fenar and Cirren voluntarily support continuing inquiry. No opposed check, no money, time approx15 minutes. D315~11:30 Caereth palace private council chamber. V/Elara/Mara/Cirren/Fenar with security councillor and secretary. V expressly authorizes certified copies of all presented Kestrel evidence, not surrender of originals; secretary begins supervised copying of key records, no complete certified set or authentication yet, originals remain in V's presence/custody, physical exhibits Fenar-held, notes Mara-held. V states desire to discover and dismantle abuses on disputed fronts/borders, even independently if necessary, not declaration of war, acceptance of specific expedition or House-wide commitments. Fenar and Cirren independently express willingness to continue investigating. Councillor raises distinct actionable frontier lead: an indirect military warning originating from an Orseld-area frontier post, issued D306, carried via established ordinary border liaison courier channels and received in Caereth D313, describes raiders appearing in differing rival-country colors on separate nights with similar field tactics; attribution uncertain, no proof of Veyran link, no current threat location/timetable established, no hidden cell identities/roster revealed. Councillor offers access to the report and a written introduction to frontier liaison contacts for independent investigation; no dispatch/letter handed over yet, no Crown authorization to wage war, no cash or commission accepted. Crown confidential authentication and survivor inquiry proposed/authorized copies only; public statement or diplomacy pending verification and sovereign decision. V chooses next response or asks to review report/accept introduction; D315 late afternoon guild meeting remains planned. All stats and wealth unchanged: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 all resources full, cloak+Luckstone; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 full slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; Mara/Elara/horses healthy. Rest5/6 food21/feed28 purse203gp4sp6cp, conditional240gp sale unpaid, other loot unverified, no new costs. Dice delegated until stop.
